events.title: Month-end apartment move-outs
events.area: Apartment-heavy areas: near USF, Brandon, Lakeland's south side
events.tip: Leases end on the last day of the month, so curbside furniture and appliances spike for a couple of days. Curbside only; ask before taking anything from a property.

events.title: Fight the Blight: Holiday Village/Town 'N Country
events.tip: Residents put out furniture, junk, metal, electronics and tires for a county pickup all week; piles go out the night before each day. Curbside only.

events.title: USF Tampa dorm move-out
events.area: USF Tampa: off-campus apartments along Fletcher Ave, Bruce B Downs and 42nd St
events.tip: Exams run Dec 5-10 and residence halls close at noon Fri Dec 11; students leave within 24 hours of their last exam. Look for curbside piles on public streets; ask before taking anything from an apartment property.

events.title: USF St. Petersburg move-out (estimated)
events.area: Downtown St. Pete around the USF St. Petersburg campus
events.tip: Estimate: halls closed at noon on the second Friday of December last year.

events.title: University of Tampa move-out
events.area: Around the University of Tampa (Hyde Park, North Hyde Park, West Tampa)
events.tip: Students must be out by 10 a.m. Fri Dec 18; loading zones run Dec 16-18.

events.title: Florida Southern College move-out
events.area: Around Florida Southern, Lake Hollingsworth and Dixieland, Lakeland
events.tip: The undergraduate fall term ends Dec 19.

events.title: Month-end apartment move-outs
events.area: Apartment-heavy areas: near USF, Brandon, Lakeland's south side
events.tip: Leases end on the last day of the month, so curbside furniture and appliances spike for a couple of days. Curbside only; ask before taking anything from a property.

tips.title: Tampa S.W.E.E.P. bulky pickups
tips.text: Each Tampa neighborhood gets one scheduled bulky-item pickup a year (furniture, appliances, grills, mattresses) and residents can set piles out up to 5 days before their week. Look up areas by address.

tips.title: Unincorporated Polk County furniture and appliance days
tips.text: Polk County homes outside city limits have set furniture and appliance pickup days by area, so piles show up on predictable days. Look up days by address.

tips.title: Lakeland, St. Pete and Hillsborough bulk pickups
tips.text: These are booked one household at a time, so curb piles appear on random days; the listings scan is the best way to catch them.
